msg.usage: Usage: wallpaper import|apply|next|mode fill|fit|toggle|rotation fixed|random|toggle|off|status|state|set-current ID|remove [--confirm] [--delete-original] ID [--app-dir DIR]
msg.binary_missing: bin/wallpaper is missing. Reinstall the app.
msg.busy: Still working. Please wait a minute.
msg.started: Working on your pictures. This takes about a minute.
msg.import_failed: Pictures that could not be used: {count}. See data/log.txt.
msg.applied: Sleep screen ready: {count} picture(s). Press power to see it.
msg.sleep_screen_hint: Turn on in Settings → Energy saving and privacy: “Show current read” and “Show book cover full screen”.
msg.mode_fill: Fill: pictures cover the screen (edges cropped). Re-fitted: {count}.
msg.mode_fit: Fit: whole picture on white. Re-fitted: {count}.
msg.mode_saved: Saved. Import pictures to use it.
msg.err_tempfile: Cannot create a temporary file for {path}. Is the storage full?
msg.err_mode_invalid: Unknown mode: {value}. Use fill or fit.
msg.err_rotation_invalid: Unknown rotation: {value}. Use fixed or random.
msg.err_config_read: Cannot read settings {path}: {cause}. Delete the file to reset.
msg.err_index_read: Cannot read the picture list {path}: {cause}. Delete data/images to reset.
msg.err_device_unknown: Screen size of {model} ({id}) is not known yet.
msg.err_device_unreadable: Cannot read the device id in {path}: {cause}
msg.err_not_image: Not a PNG or JPEG picture.
msg.err_no_pictures: No pictures yet. Copy PNG or JPEG files to Pictures, then Import pictures.
actions.state.label: Screen state
msg.mode_saved_for_job: Saved. The running job re-fits the pictures when it ends.
msg.removed: Removed picture {id} ({name}) from Wallpaper. The original stays in Pictures.
msg.removed_original: Removed picture {id} ({name}) and deleted its original from Pictures.
msg.removed_original_kept: Removed picture {id} ({name}). The original in Pictures was kept: no identical file was found.
msg.err_removed_read: Cannot read the removed-pictures list {path}: {cause}. Delete the file to reset.
msg.err_picture_id_invalid: Not a picture number: {value}. Use a number such as 0003 or 3.
msg.err_picture_unknown: There is no picture {id}. Open the gallery and pick one from the list.
msg.err_confirm_needed: Picture {id} was not removed: add --confirm to confirm. The original in Pictures is never deleted without --delete-original.
msg.picture_missing: No picture was chosen. Pick a picture in the gallery.
ui.title: Wallpaper
ui.remove_text: The picture leaves Wallpaper. The original in the Pictures folder is kept.
ui.empty_text: Copy PNG or JPEG pictures to the Pictures folder over USB, or send them with LocalSend
ui.toast_failed: That did not work. See data/log.txt.
ui.rotation_random_detail: A different picture each time it sleeps
actions.set-current.label: Set as wallpaper
ui.remove_original_text: The picture leaves Wallpaper and its original in the Pictures folder is deleted for good, but only if it is the identical file.
ui.toast_removed_original_kept: Removed. No identical original, so none was deleted.
actions.remove-all.label: Remove with original
